bio.text: Toby Ann Stavisky is a Democratic member of the New York State Senate representing District 11 and, according to Ballotpedia, is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
She was born in New York City and earned a B.A. from Syracuse University and master's degrees from Queens College and Hunter College.
Her earlier work included being a social studies teacher in New York City high schools and working in the actuarial department of an insurance company.
